integrity: Mathematical argument for all algebraically closed characteristic-five parameters; independently reproducible exact arithmetic for base-field and extension-field samples. Verification is self-review only, with no independent validation.
limitations: The smooth fixed-normalization cyclic-six family only; marked coefficient parameters rather than isomorphism classes. The full Newton polygons at positive 5-rank parameters are not classified; the explicit zeta applies only to (4,2). Residual possibility of unindexed earlier calculations.
title: Characteristic-five \(p\)-rank strata and a unique supersingular curve in a genus-four cyclic-six family
